## Dispatch order · `domain:ui#5` · `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C` · 2026-10-29T05:58Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#27417, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone: read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` and `ui/AGENTS.md` before your first edit, and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself through REST (`curl -sS "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/27417" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`, every page); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`). ⛔ Never use a GitHub MCP tool, read or write.

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; its `Branch:` line names your thread's branch. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names your thread's branch (`claude/project-thread-…`); if none does yet, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message with your branch name and wait. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27417` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main`; `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27417 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (timestamps only as `{{WAS:…}}` / the now-token). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27417`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Changeset in the root `.changeset/` when a published package changes (`@object-ui/i18n` patch for namespace rows; app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Take another ui lane seat" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.
Collision check: ui seats 1 and 2 both answered at 2026-10-29T05:56Z that neither holds an order, claim or plan on #27355 rows 9–10.

**Out of bounds, from seat 2.** PR #27305 (#27159) is open and rewrites:
- plugin-form `ObjectForm.tsx` and `index.tsx`; it also adds `ObjectFormContainer.tsx` and deletes `SplitForm.tsx`;
- `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm`;
- the form types in `ui/packages/types`;
- `component.zod.ts`.

Stay in the console public-form page. If the fix needs any of those files, stop and send the seat thread one message.

Measure open PRs on every file you touch at your first edit.

### Card

#27417 holds rows 9–10 of #27355 (HotCRM 18.2.0). Its body holds the seat's code reading on `origin/main` `45c9be5f`. Treat that reading as the mechanism assumptions to measure; disproof is welcome.
- **Row 10.** `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` writes every refusal to `setError` + `toast.error` only (≈L2475–2498 client, ≈L2670–2675 server). Mark each refused field: `aria-invalid` and its message under the control. Reuse the record dialog's existing reader of the server's field paths; ⛔ write no second parser. Name the reader you reused in the report.
- **Row 9.** First measure whether the page knows its app.
  - On the in-app route `/apps/:appName/forms/:name`, the app theme should already apply. If it doesn't, that's the fix.
  - On the app-less `/forms/:name`, find out whether the served form definition, or its object, names an app whose `branding` is readable without auth.
  - If no door exists, deliver the in-app half and the body-font placeholder, then record the app-less brand as an `open_questions` entry with options. ⛔ Don't invent a server read.

### Measure first

Use real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) on a fixture form, before and after. Record:
- the refused field's `aria-invalid` and the message under the control;
- the submit button's computed background against the app's `--primary`;
- the placeholder's computed `font-family`.

### Scope

File surface: console `src/components/FormPage.tsx`, plus a small shared helper only if the record dialog's reader must be lifted. Name it in the report. Tests go beside it. Stop on any breach and explain it in the report.

Tests (acceptance):
- A server refusal naming fields A and B marks both.
- The client required refusal marks the missing fields.
- A refusal naming no field marks none.
- Ablation: revert the marking and the pins go red.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate is expected; run `dispatch-gates --tier` and follow it. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `medium` (S–M). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, unless a measured export or key says otherwise; then stop and tell the seat. The console app is `private: true`. A shared package you touch takes a `patch` changeset.
